verdict.rationale: Obsidian's official docs describe a dedicated Importer plugin covering Notion, Evernote, Airtable, and OneNote, converting workspaces into durable local Markdown files while preserving structure (e.g., Notion databases converted to Bases), and native support for plain Markdown vaults is inherent to the app. Community evidence corroborates real-world migration from Roam to Obsidian as a positive experience. missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of a Roam importer, and detailed confirmation that attachments/links are always preserved losslessly across all four sources.
